newsitem.title: CHINA: China opens big carbon-free paper complex.
newsitem.headline: China opens big carbon-free paper complex.

text.p: China has opened a carbon-free paper complex in the eastern city of Qingdao with an annual capacity of 12,000 tonnes, the China Business Weekly said on Sunday.
The Qingdao Aohua Paper Industry Ltd is a joint venture funded by three companies from Qingdao, France and Hong Kong, the newspaper said without giving further details.
The second phase of the project was expected to raise annual capacity to 50,000 tonnes, it said, though it did not say when this would begin.
China currently relies on imports for almost half the carbon-free paper it uses, the newspaper said.
